title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Lead Data Analyst

Location: London, Manchester or Bristol (Predominantly Remote)
Rate: £600 per day Inside IR35
Contract Length: Until End of Financial Year (March/April)
Clearance: BPSS Required

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst to support a high-profile government programme focused on improving data quality, reconciliation, and decision-making across multiple organisations.

This role will suit a strong analytical professional who can work with complex datasets from different sources, identify inconsistencies, establish data quality standards, and provide evidence-based recommendations to senior stakeholders. The successful candidate will be comfortable handling ambiguity, working independently, and translating detailed technical analysis into meaningful business outcomes.

Candidates from government, local authority, or private-sector environments will be considered where they can demonstrate strong experience in data reconciliation, quality assurance, and stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the analysis of service, application, and technology records from multiple organisations.
  • Reconcile datasets using SQL and other analytical tools to determine whether records relate to the same entities.
  • Work with data owners to agree definitions, standards, and quality assurance processes.
  • Investigate discrepancies, trace findings back to source systems, and document unresolved issues.
  • Identify missing, incomplete, or inconsistent data and implement quality improvement approaches.
  • Develop repeatable data quality checks and reconciliation processes.
  • Produce clear evidence-based recommendations for service owners and stakeholders.
  • Present analytical findings and their limitations to non-technical audiences.
  • Assess whether pilot activities improve existing processes and decision-making capabilities.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience analysing and reconciling complex datasets from multiple sources.
  • Advanced SQL skills or equivalent data querying experience.
  • Experience with data profiling, data quality assessment, and reconciliation methodologies.
  • Ability to identify patterns, anomalies, and inconsistencies within large datasets.
  • Experience working with metadata, data lineage, and data governance principles.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, including working with data owners to validate findings.
  • Ability to communicate technical analysis and recommendations to non-technical audiences.
  • Experience delivering analytical outputs that directly support business decisions.
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in fast-paced environments.


Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Experience within Central Government, Local Government, or wider Public Sector organisations.
  • Experience reconciling data across multiple organisations or departments.
  • Python, R, or Power BI experience.
  • Business Intelligence, Insight Analysis, or Data Governance experience.
  • Knowledge of service, application, or technology asset data.
  • Experience supporting data-driven transformation or improvement initiatives.


Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of resolving data inconsistencies between multiple sources and translating complex analysis into practical recommendations. You will be able to demonstrate situations where conflicting datasets were investigated, validated with stakeholders, and ultimately used to drive business decisions.

You will combine strong technical analytical skills with excellent communication, enabling you to bridge the gap between data, business stakeholders, and operational decision-making.
